  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The idempotency guard `((.body // "") | rtrimstr("\n") | endswith($marker))` strips only one trailing newline, so a body ending in multiple newlines fails the check.
  WHY: The guard can then post a duplicate comment when a close is retried. Source severity was MAJOR, mapped to medium.   WHY: The suggested fix is `gsub("\\s+$"; "")` before `endswith($marker)`. The reviewer says it does not reproduce today, because the posted comment has no trailing newline and GitHub stores the body verbatim.
